cmake_policy(SET CMP0077 NEW)

set(MSDF_ATLAS_BUILD_STANDALONE OFF)
set(MSDF_ATLAS_USE_SKIA OFF)
set(MSDF_ATLAS_NO_ARTERY_FONT ON)
set(MSDFGEN_DISABLE_PNG ON)

set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF)

set(SDLMIXER_DEPS_SHARED OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VENDORED OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_FLAC OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_GME OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MOD OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MP3 OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MIDI OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_OPUS OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VORBIS_STB ON)
set(SDLMIXER_VORBIS_VORBISFILE OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_WAVPACK OFF)

if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Linux")
    set(PLUME_SDL3_VULKAN_ENABLED ON CACHE BOOL "")
endif()

if (WIN32)
    set(PLUME_D3D12_AGILITY_SDK_ENABLED ON CACHE BOOL "")
endif()


add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/msdf-atlas-gen")

add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/discord-rpc")
add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/o1heap")
add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/SDL")
add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/SDL_mixer")
add_subdirectory("${HEROES_RECOMP_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/plume")
